# MealModel

The Julia version of the Mixed Meal Model. Originally developed by S.D. O'Donovan[^1]

## Getting Started

To get started, first clone the github repository to your own device

Then, open the notebook "MealModel.ipynb" in your Jupyter Notebook viewer, and run the first cell to set-up the environment.
